scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I applied for a home improvement loan, and I wanted to know if there's been any update on my application.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and originated. The loan amount is $65,000 with a term of 180 months. The interest rate is 3.490%. The property value is $305,000.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the update. I see that my application was approved. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features. The loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution.

dialogue.user: Great, that's reassuring to hear. I also wanted to ask, what is my debt-to-income ratio, and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is between 20% and 30%. The loan product type is a Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. <Satisfied> The conversation was helpful and you provided all the information I was looking for.
